newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on speculative trade.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed on Sunday amid speculative trade in anticipation of fresh buying by foreign funds, dealers said.
"Anticipatory buying by speculators may continue but there is unlikely to be a major cash inflow or genuine buying," dealer Shakeel Anwar Kamal said.
On Thursday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 16.99 points, or 1.26 percent, to end at 1,370.33. Losers led gainers 119 to 109.
Turnover rose to 23 million shares from 20 million in the previous session. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
